reasons.poPartiallyReceivedNeedsReceipt: Receive the goods first — create a goods receipt and the order status updates by itself.
reasons.poReceivedNeedsFullReceipt: This order isn't fully received yet. Record a goods receipt for every remaining quantity and the status becomes “Received” automatically.
reasons.transitionNotAllowed: You can't move this order from “{{from}}” to “{{to}}”.
reasons.invoiceCancelledFrozen: This invoice is cancelled — its status can no longer be changed.
reasons.invoicePaidFrozen: This invoice is already paid, so it can't be moved to “{{to}}”.
reasons.receiveWrongStatus: Goods can only be received once the order is sent to the supplier (current status: “{{status}}”).
reasons.poItemsFrozen: Items can't be changed on an order in status “{{status}}”. Create a new order or a credit note instead.
reasons.poTotalsFrozen: Discount and fiscal stamp can't be changed on an order in status “{{status}}”.
reasons.invoiceItemsDraftOnly: Invoice lines can only be edited while the invoice is a draft.
reasons.receiptLockedByInvoice: This goods receipt is already invoiced, so it can't be edited. Cancel the invoice first.
reasons.receiptLineRelinkBlocked: A receipt line can't be moved to a different order line. Delete the line and add it again.
reasons.deletePoHasReceipts: Delete the goods receipts linked to this order first.
reasons.deletePoHasInvoices: This order is already invoiced. Delete or cancel the supplier invoices first.
reasons.cancelPoHasInvoices: This order can't be cancelled while supplier invoices reference it. Delete or credit those invoices first.
reasons.deleteReceiptHasInvoices: This goods receipt is referenced by a supplier invoice. Delete that invoice first.
reasons.deleteInvoiceDeclared: This invoice was already declared to the DGI (TEJ). File an annulment instead of deleting it.
reasons.deleteInvoicePaid: This invoice has recorded payments. Reverse the payment or cancel the invoice first.
reasons.deleteItemReceived: This line has already been received, so it can't be deleted. Cancel the goods receipt first.
reasons.invoiceMoreThanReceived: You can't invoice more than what was received (only {{received}} received). Record the goods receipt first.
reasons.invoiceMoreThanOrdered: You can't invoice more than what was ordered (only {{ordered}} ordered).
reasons.overReceiptRemaining: You're receiving more than what's left on the order — only {{remaining}} remaining.
reasons.overReceipt: You're receiving more than the quantity still expected on this order.
reasons.qtyBelowReceived: The quantity can't be lower than what's already received ({{received}}).
reasons.negativeReceived: The received quantity can't be negative.
reasons.negativeRejected: The rejected quantity can't be negative.
reasons.lineQtyZero: Each line needs a quantity greater than zero.
reasons.lineNegativePrice: A unit price can't be negative.
reasons.lineTaxRange: The tax rate must be between 0 and 100%.
reasons.negativeAmountPaid: The amount paid can't be negative.
reasons.overpayment: The amount paid ({{paid}}) is higher than the invoice total ({{total}}). It may have just been settled — reload and check.
reasons.stockReverseShortage: Not enough stock left to reverse this movement — some items were already used or sold.
reasons.differentSupplier: The selected documents belong to different suppliers.
reasons.itemNotOnOrder: One of the lines doesn't belong to the selected purchase order.
reasons.invoiceHasNoOrder: Link this invoice to a purchase order before adding order lines.
reasons.supplierAlreadyLinked: This supplier is already linked to that article.
reasons.duplicateInvoiceRef: Invoice reference “{{ref}}” already exists for this supplier.
reasons.poNotFound: This purchase order no longer exists.
reasons.receiptNotFound: This goods receipt no longer exists.
reasons.invoiceNotFound: This supplier invoice no longer exists.
reasons.articleSupplierNotFound: This article–supplier link no longer exists.
reasons.itemNotFound: This line no longer exists — it may have been deleted meanwhile.
